register.labelZh: COME OUT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: COME OUT Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: come out 可以描述太陽、月亮或星星出現。；come out at 可以表示帳單、預訂或購物的最後費用。；come out in 可以描述疹子或紅點;come out of 則可以描述逐漸走出困難情況。；你可以用 come out 表示從某處出來,並用 come out with 表示突然說出令人意外的話。
register.summaryEn: Come out can describe the sun, moon or stars becoming visible. Come out at helps you say what a bill, booking or purchase finally costs. Come out in can describe a rash or spots, while come out of can describe recovery from a difficult situation. You can use come out for leaving a place and come out with for saying something surprising.

Read the words after out carefully: come out at £50 come out in a rash come out of the room come out of recession come out with a strange comment Come out can be used by itself, but the situation determines its meaning: The sun came out.
